summary: Variables can be set per host or per group in inventory, e.g. a shared NTP server for the boston group.
questions: Can I set variables for a group of hosts in inventory?

answer_card.title: Variables in inventory
answer_card.answer_md: Set variables per host, or for a whole group (e.g. all `[boston]` hosts use `boston.ntp.example.com`). See the inventory docs for host and group variables.
